sources.quote: Pi Herculis, Latinized from π Herculis, formally named Nüchuang, is a third-magnitude star in the constellation Hercules.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 1,256 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,181 K, so 67.631 solar radii.

sources.quote: As one of the four stars in the Keystone asterism, specifically representing the northeastern corner, it is one of the constellation's more easily recognized.
